maps.title: ARK OUTSKIRTS
maps.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: game level-design planning map. Create ONE detailed high resolution landscape planning sheet, true orthographic TOP DOWN camera directly vertical, no isometric perspective, no horizon. Hand-painted environment map with crisp architectural plan readability, tasteful restrained anime-background textures. Map fills 80 percent of sheet with slim right legend. Distinct real geographic landmarks and readable connected walkable paths, not a generic arena, not a MOBA three-lane map. Show traversable ground light, impassable rocks/buildings/tree clusters dark, interiors roofless. Roughly 60 percent walkable. Broad combat pockets linked by 6-10 m paths, several loops and flanking routes, no long dead ends. Label eight landmarks clearly with small unobtrusive leader lines. Small north arrow, faint 20 m planning grid, approximate scale bar. Cyan square A for arrival lift at south edge, cyan outline squares L1 L2 L3 for three dormant lifts spread around remaining map unless boss-specific override. Small gold diamonds denote optional objective sites. Thin dashed warm-white lines only where needed to clarify secondary paths, actual paths must be drawn physically. Legend: Walkable / Blocked / Arrival / Dormant lift / Objective / Alternate route. Title exact location name; subtitle 'LAYOUT STUDY 01 - PROPOSED'. No characters, HUD, perspective buildings, decorative charts, or lengthy text. Geography and routes should be useful to a level designer. 
Location title: ARK OUTSKIRTS
Specific geography: 160 x 160 m concept. Open destroyed city edge. Asymmetric broad boulevard loop with pedestrian crosscuts around broken apartment footprints. Landmarks: Arrival Plaza, Collapsed Lift, Market Arcade, Reservoir, Transit Yard, Relay Court, Rubble Gardens, East Depot. Spacious long sight lines. Concrete gray, dusty olive.
